upstream.name: sddai/markerPDF
upstream.architecture: Python PDF-to-Markdown extraction pipeline using pdftext, pypdfium2, Surya OCR/layout models, table/equation/image extraction, and Markdown post-processing.

benchmarkDenominator.total: 27 inspected upstream benchmark/test/cleanup artifacts: 1 CI workflow, 1 benchmark runner, 2 benchmark scoring modules, 1 score verifier, 6 benchmark documents, 8 committed reference-like markdown outputs, 7 cleaner modules, and 1 Markdown postprocessor
benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow upstream clone at .upstream-cache/markerpdf plus targeted reads of README.md, .github/workflows/tests.yml, benchmarks/overall.py, marker/benchmark/scoring.py, marker/benchmark/table.py, scripts/verify_benchmark_scores.py, marker/pdf/extract_text.py, marker/postprocessors/markdown.py, marker/cleaners/*.py, and data/examples/*/*.md paths. The mapped surrogate fixtures sample README-linked committed output pairs for multicolcnn.pdf, switch_trans.pdf, and thinkpython.pdf from data/examples/marker/*.md and data/examples/nougat/*.md.
benchmarkDenominator.ciAssertionSource: scripts/verify_benchmark_scores.py checks multicolcnn.pdf > 0.34 and switch_trans.pdf > 0.40 for marker output, plus average table score >= 0.7 for table reports.
benchmarkDenominator.runnerBlocker: The upstream CI benchmark downloads benchmark_data from Google Drive and requires Poetry plus heavy Python dependencies including torch, surya-ocr, pdftext, pypdfium2, tabled-pdf, and model downloads. The shallow clone contains no benchmark PDFs or references, so the full runner cannot execute locally under the modest network/CPU constraint.
mappedSemantics: PDF content stream text operators feed Marker-style Markdown conversion.
PDF text movement operators define block-ready line boundaries before WordPress import.
marker.postprocessors.markdown line_separator hyphen dewrapping joins split words across extracted lines.
marker.postprocessors.markdown block_surround heading/list/text wrapping and hash escaping.
marker.benchmark.scoring chunk_text, overlap_score, and score_text chunked text-alignment workflow.
marker.benchmark.table split_to_cells pipe-cell parsing and repeated-space removal.
marker.benchmark.table align_rows best hypothesis-row selection with rapidfuzz-style cutoff scores.
marker.benchmark.table score_table aggregate cell-alignment score with upstream verifier threshold applied to a WordPress table-import scenario.
marker.cleaners.bullets replace_bullets converts upstream bullet glyphs to Markdown list markers.
marker.cleaners.text cleanup_text collapses excessive blank space and normalizes non-breaking spaces.
README-linked multicolcnn Marker/Nougat committed markdown outputs can be scored as an upstream-derived surrogate pair while the external benchmark_data archive remains unavailable.
README-linked switch_trans Marker/Nougat committed markdown outputs can be scored as a second upstream-derived surrogate pair and checked against the upstream switch_trans CI threshold boundary.
marker.cleaners.headers filter_common_elements and filter_header_footer repeated edge-line detection remove common PDF page headers/footers after the upstream three-page minimum.
marker.cleaners.headers replace_leading_trailing_digits, find_overlap_elements, and filter_common_titles remove repeated numbered titles before WordPress block rendering.
README-linked thinkpython Marker/Nougat committed markdown outputs can be scored as a third upstream-derived surrogate pair while the external benchmark_data archive remains unavailable.
marker.cleaners.code is_code_linelen and comment_count heuristics detect code-like PDF lines from short alphanumeric line ratios and upstream-supported comment prefixes.
marker.cleaners.code identify_code_blocks indentation/comment majority and optional small-font checks classify code blocks before WordPress block rendering.
marker.cleaners.code indent_blocks reconstructs indentation from PDF line geometry and suppresses repeated blank lines before code block output.
benchmarkDenominator.warning: This replaces the seed denominator with a cloned static inventory, not upstream runner parity. Native PHP progress maps 18 focused upstream source semantics plus three committed upstream-derived benchmark surrogate pairs; no external upstream benchmark PDF/reference archive pair is mapped yet because the external benchmark_data archive was not fetched.
